page.overview:
Who is Tera?

Tera was the daughter of a bandit from the East Blue. She is the mother of Roronoa Zoro, as well as the wife of Roronoa Arashi.

Based on her silhouette, Tera had long hair worn in a ponytail and prominent eyelashes.

Tera was the daughter of a bandit from the East Blue. At some point, she married a man named Roronoa Arashi from the Shimotsuki Village, and twenty-one years ago, they had a son named Roronoa Zoro. She later died of an illness.
